s: The recent and ongoing expansion of data centers associated with increasing demand for artificial intelligence (AI) and other cloud‑based services is a national trend.
We could be adversely affected by changes in the development, and utilization by our customers, of power generation, storage, and use technologies, as well as emerging technologies such as AI.
AI-driven energy management tools could also enable customers to optimize usage and further reduce purchases from us.
Moreover, the rapid evolution and increased adoption of AI technologies may intensify our cybersecurity risks.
